hypotheticalOnly: Assume a and b are not parallel and intersect at P; then there would be two parallels to c through P. This is contradictory and rejected.
modernAdditions: Regularize all three solid portions to horizontal while preserving their ordering and the two distinct dashed crossing continuations.
Use semantic ink, consistent solid/dash vector styles and a hidden P marker with its visible renderer-owned label.
Provide English/math labels at least 16 CSS px at widths 300, 358 and 640; no new answer annotations or hypothetical relation labels inside the figure.
multiPointRequirement: Only one named source point; native two-point group requirement is inapplicable. Its incident strokes use literal endpoints, not invented source points.
unresolved: Native FigureSpec has no contradiction-schematic assertion scope for full turned a/b paths parallel to c and meeting at P. Stroke-only checks do not certify the complete mathematical schematic.
